scope: Actual retail VM 472030 runs push/store integer and float instructions 42..45 and subsequent integer/float global reads. Covers four manager integers -9926..-9923, eight manager floats -9922..-9915, four Boss integer and four Boss float destinations with Boss present/absent, and writable absolute/relative XY positions -9995..-9992. Native 423f80/424c10 writable-reference dispatch and 423810/424110 read dispatch execute without stubs; all 39 watched storage words and typed read results agree across 352 cases, including large signed integers, NaN/infinity and signed zero. Boss-missing writes fall back to owner storage while reads return zero. No claim about remaining globals, callbacks, complete gameplay or position recombination after writes.
